intro.text: A mountain in Terris, one of the lower peaks of the Terris ranges.

description.text: At some times of year the mountain is hard to reach.

items.text: Sazed told Vin and Elend that the Well of Ascension lay at Derytatith and urged them to leave Luthadel to seek it, arguing that their absence would let power change hands peacefully. They set out for the Terris mountains the next morning. Sazed had made the story up to save them, believing the city would fall.
